usability.name: Login — time to first interaction
usability.observation: Measure time from app open to being able to log a workout. Firebase auth should auto-login returning users within 2 seconds.

usability.name: Target pill discoverability
usability.observation: Is it obvious that the target pill is tappable? Does the 'Tap to copy target values to form' tooltip appear reliably on mobile?

usability.name: Exceeded weight dialog clarity
usability.heuristic: Nielsen #2: Match between system and real world
usability.observation: Does the dialog clearly say HOW MANY exercises exceeded target and that ONLY weight is updated (not sets/reps)?

usability.name: Running page hidden by default
usability.heuristic: Nielsen #7: Flexibility and efficiency of use
usability.observation: Power users who want Running must discover the toggle in Settings. Is there any hint in the nav or onboarding?

usability.name: Timer scroll pickers vs number input
usability.observation: Scroll pickers are unusual for time input on web. Are they intuitive on mobile? Do they respond well to swipe gestures?
